sections.heading: A transverse motor and worm reduction fit a slow placement job.
paragraphs: The factory Axial 88T brushed motor and SPMXSE3225RX combined radio/controller keep the SCX30 system compact. Worm reduction and an accessible transmission support its crawling purpose, while the angled skid and ramped axle shapes aim to reduce obstacle snags. Those shapes do not create traction when a tire is unsupported. If the Bronco is hung up, change the approach or reverse out instead of holding the motor stalled. The mechanical details justify a crawling shortlist without an untested maximum-angle or torque claim.

The documented Axial 88T brushed motor, AXI-3285 is the power equipment evaluated for SCX30 Ford Bronco.
